source.description: A worldwide research snapshot spanning films, serials, television movies, series, soap operas, individual episodes and short-form vertical dramas across sixty-three themes. The expanded index now includes a dedicated worldwide view of female characters hypnotized, brainwashed or magically controlled into agreeing to marriage, undergoing a wedding while controlled, or having children after such a marriage; a dedicated worldwide view of doctors and therapists who control female characters for sexual exploitation, crime cover-ups, programmed crime, financial or power gains, and possessive control; a dedicated worldwide view of polygamy plus pregnancy and depicted or reported intimate/sex scenes, separated into multiple-wife plots, royal-harem and concubine dramas, modern polygamous households, a polyandry variant and unresolved leads; it also retains the dedicated view of polygamy plus female hypnosis, mind control, possession, occult control or coercive indoctrination, separated into strict multiple-wife matches, concurrent-partner harem variants, cult variants, borderlines and related cross-references; adult/18+ works and unresolved cases are labeled plainly; and separates strict hypnosis during pregnancy from possession, therapeutic, cult, fetal-targeting and control-caused-pregnancy variants; gives non-pregnant Indian-language cases their own regional view; and includes women who knowingly or unknowingly bargain with a devil- or demon-coded force to become pregnant or have a child, with the pregnancy outcome stated; women hypnotized or mind-controlled by a husband, boyfriend, ex-husband or ex-boyfriend, with direct matches separated from third-party, occult, adult-audience and unresolved variants; adult-audience films and television in which hypnosis, possession or mind control overlaps a pregnancy or causes it; the worldwide adult-audience search for mothers controlled by a current husband or boyfriend; wives who are already mothers becoming pregnant by another man; partnered women hypnotized or mind-controlled into infidelity; the 180-entry worldwide adult-audience sweep of wives and other adult female characters subjected to hypnosis, mesmerism, hypnotic suggestion, erotic supernatural thrall or explicitly framed occult trance; wives and other female characters forcibly hypnotized into obedience; stepmothers or bonus moms hypnotized, possessed, cursed or enchanted against their will; pregnant stepmothers and bonus moms; the closest documented cases of a remarried wife controlled by her new husband or a stepfather figure; a pregnant single mother controlled by her new husband or child’s stepfather; pregnant women controlled by unborn, ghost or alien children; female characters controlled by children or teens; current wives controlled or possessed by a husband’s former wife or lover; wives hypnotized or controlled by therapists; parents being intimate while children sleep; the expanded worldwide index of children interrupting or witnessing their parents’ intimate moments; adoption followed by pregnancy; human-villain hypnosis; vampire mesmerism; demonic and occult control; spirit or djinn possession; tantrik and vashikaran plots; sci-fi control; cult brainwashing; therapeutic hypnosis; fantasy enchantment; and the expanded worldwide index of pregnant characters in sexual, sensual, romantic, attempted, labor-related or fantasy scenes.

source.research_notes_html:
Boundaries & open questions

Female hypnotized into marriage: 23 memberships across three outcome buckets

The 3 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed about 180 search rounds across eight language, region and format vectors. Twenty-one findings are represented as distinct records, including four corrected entries that had previously been mistaken for existing records; two genuinely existing titles gained membership without duplicate cards.

  • Three plot buckets: A covers agreement to marriage under control; B covers a wedding performed while control is active; C tracks children after such a marriage. Titles that satisfy more than one bucket appear in each relevant subsection.
  • Mechanism honesty: literal trance, mesmerism, fantasy magic, hypnotic devices, implanted memories, drugs, cult coercion, occult ritual, djinn wishes and timeline rewriting are labeled separately.
  • Children after: only Eterna Magia verifies a child after the spell-driven marriage. A rumor about The Love by Hypnotic remains unconfirmed and is not counted.
  • Adult / erotic coverage: the dedicated adult and R-rated screen search returned no verified title. Two Japanese adult games found through the East Asian vector are included with 18+ labels and single-source caveats.
  • Held outside the category: The Devil’s Sonata lacks a verified marriage element; Kavach… Kaali Shaktiyon Se is possession during a wedding rather than control that causes the marriage; and O Beijo do Vampiro has confirmed hypnosis followed by pregnancy but no marriage, with paternity unresolved.
Female hypnosis deep sweep: 7 verified additions after full-catalog dedupe

The 2 October 2026 pass ran about 117 search rounds across mainstream vertical platforms, adult and erotic screen indexes, recent releases, smaller short-drama platforms and multilingual searches. Seven verified findings are now represented in their existing plot categories: two forced-obedience memberships and five hypno-intimacy memberships.

  • Vertical short: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees is the one new verified vertical drama. ReelShort’s official episode 6 page identifies the “Eyes of Rom” hypnosis beat involving Cathey; the card carries the vertical-short badge.
  • Memory-manipulation variant: O Hipnotizador S02E02 “Teresa e as Mariposas” is cross-filed into forced obedience, with the caveat that the episode concerns false-memory manipulation rather than a direct command.
  • 18+ explicit additions: The Hypnotist (1936), PPPD-305, Saimin Seishidou / Hypnosis Sex Guidance, Kyonyuu Onna Shikan Sennou Saimin and Saimin Jutsu the Animation 2nd are filed in hypno-intimacy. The two similarly named adult-animation titles are explicitly distinguished from the already-cataloged Kyonyuu Hitozuma Onna Kyoushi Saimin and Saimin Jutsu Zero.
  • Dedupe: four are net-new catalog records; three enrich existing rows. Eleven other researched titles were already represented and were not duplicated. Saimin (1999) remains excluded from female-victim categories because the documented hypnosis victims are male.
  • Unresolved leads: 17 LOW-confidence or title-only leads remain outside the catalog, including My Childhood Friend Hypnotized Me To Love Another, several unidentified dubbed edits and adult listings without enough plot-level support.
  • Honest zeros: no additional adult-only vertical short was verified on the legitimate platforms searched; post-1 October releases, the reviewed obscure-platform indexes and the additional language corners also returned no net-new verified title.
Doctor controls female characters for personal gain: 20 verified findings, 7 existing-record overlaps

The 2 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed films, television series and episodes, daytime soaps, telenovelas and adult animation across seven regional and format vectors. Twenty verified findings are grouped by motive; seven already-cataloged titles receive category membership without duplicate records.

  • Five motive groups: 4 sexual-exploitation findings; 5 crime cover-up, silencing or framing stories; 5 cases where a patient is programmed to commit crimes; 4 money, inheritance or power grabs; and 2 romantic or possessive-control stories.
  • Confidence: 13 findings are high confidence and 7 medium. The 17 low-confidence leads are not filed.
  • Mechanism honesty: cards distinguish classical trance from implanted chips, drugs, gaslighting, psychiatric conditioning, machine mind-control, non-trance manipulation, memory alteration and fantasy hypnosis.
  • Special flags: adult and erotic works, female doctors, the 19-year-old patient in Augustine, school settings, a non-doctor counsellor edge and the teen-victim caveat on the 2025 Thai Hypnotic remain explicit.
  • Cross-filing: qualifying sexual-exploitation cases also appear in the adult female-hypnosis doctor/therapist group and the hypnotized-intimacy view; supported forced-obedience cases are cross-filed without creating extra records.
  • Coverage limits: the sweep found no verified additions in Indian cinema or television, short-form vertical dramas, several African and Middle Eastern markets, UK soaps, or the reviewed golden-age explicit-adult and Hong Kong Category III indexes. These are research results, not proof that no other case exists.
Pregnant-woman hypnosis sweep: 1 strict update, 4 new variants or leads

The 2–3 October 2026 worldwide sweep ran 110 query rounds across 13+ languages, covering vertical-short platforms, mainstream film and television, and adult / R-rated indexes. Five catalog updates are retained after full-catalog dedupe: one existing Indonesian film gains strict-core membership, and four new mainstream film or television records join the variants-and-leads view.

  • Strict core: The Womb / Inang (2022) now records that Eva hypnotizes pregnant Wulan into agreeing to stay until after delivery. Two independent plot explainers support the pregnancy-era hypnosis; the card remains medium confidence.
  • Supported supernatural variants: Djinn (2013) and Alkarısı Cinnet (2015) are medium-confidence possession or haunting cases, not literal hypnosis. Their cards state the exact mechanism gap.
  • Unresolved leads: Cin Azabı has an unverified year and does not establish will-override; سحر أسود / Sehr El Aswad confirms a black-magic series but not a pregnant controlled victim. Both remain LOW-confidence leads.
  • Held outside the catalog: Ezedike / The Pregnant Witches is not filed because its pregnant women appear to be agents of unseen forces rather than controlled victims, and no mind-control mechanism is confirmed.
  • Honest zeros: no strict match was verified on the vertical-short platforms searched; no new verified hypno-intimacy or adult / R-rated title survived. In-app-only titles and some native-language platform searches remain an access gap, not proof of absence.
  • Dedupe: Birth, Vashikaranam – Kis Par Rakhe Vishwas, Saimin Seishidou, The Interns S1E17 (previously tracked as “Metamorphosis”) and Karishika were already represented and were not added again.
Polygamy + pregnancy + intimate / sex scenes: 99 worldwide findings

The 1–2 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed films, television series and serials, TV movies, soap operas, historical dramas and vertical shorts across ten regional and format vectors. It found 99 distinct titles or leads and grouped them by how closely all three plot elements are documented.

  • Multiple wives / partners with pregnancy: 33 records, including 10 high-confidence strict matches. Formal co-wives, bigamy, live-in parallel households and edge cases such as a mistress or sequential-marriage overlap are distinguished on each card.
  • Royal harem / concubine stories: 29 records, including 11 high-confidence titles and one medium-high title. Nine palace dramas remain low confidence because pregnancy and plural-consort structures are established but intimacy is only implied or off-screen.
  • Modern polygamous households: 8 records spanning HBO drama, Indonesian cinema, Lifetime TV movies, a fantasy-series subplot and vertical drama. Missing pregnancy or intimacy evidence is stated rather than inferred.
  • Polyandry variant: Matrubhoomi: A Nation Without Women is separated from polygyny and carries a prominent sexual-violence caveat; it is not framed as romantic polyandry.
  • Unresolved leads: 28 records remain clearly labeled because pregnancy, depicted intimacy, formal plural-marriage status, release identity or another required element is not yet verified.
  • Adult / R-rated / erotic coverage: the dedicated vector found 12 relevant adult-audience or explicit candidates, including The Concubine, Jan Dara, Versailles, Borgia and The Golden Lotus: Love and Desire. Hardcore pornography was outside the research scope.
  • Dedupe: this category reuses existing catalog rows where the same title and release year were already present, adding a category-specific view instead of a second card.
Polygamy + female hypnosis / mind control: 36 category memberships, 6 unresolved leads

The 1 October 2026 worldwide sweep and strict-scope supplement searched films, television series and serials, TV movies, soap operas, anime, documentaries and adult-audience productions across fourteen complementary regional and format vectors. The catalog now shows 33 supported or borderline research titles plus three related existing records, without adding duplicate rows.

  • Indian films: Help (Hindi), Lapachhapi (Marathi) and its Hindi remake Chhorii directly overlap pregnancy with possession or supernatural compulsion. Bandh Darwaza (Hindi) is kept separate because the verified hypnosis occurs at conception.
  • Indian television: Laal Ishq, Naagin 3 and Sasural Simar Ka have episode-recap evidence for pregnancy plus possession, hypnosis, black magic or direct mental commands.
  • Indonesia: Iblis dalam Kandungan follows pregnant Amelia as a female spirit tries to enter and possess her body to claim the baby; the available synopses do not establish whether full possession succeeds.
  • Coverage limit: no additional verified Indonesian sinetron or TV movie was found, and no separate verified Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, Bhojpuri, Odia or Assamese title met the same-character, same-pregnancy test.
Indian pregnant-woman hypnosis and mind-control pass

The consolidated 30 September 2026 Indian-language pass verified six high-confidence cases—three films and three television stories—plus one Hindi-film close variant. All involve a supernatural controller: a ghost or spirit, witches, a demonic unborn child or a vampire. The same woman must be pregnant while controlled; the conception-time variant is kept separate because hypnosis is not verified after the pregnancy begins.

  • High-confidence films: Help (Hindi), Lapachhapi (Marathi) and Chhorii (Hindi). Each directly overlaps pregnancy with possession or supernatural compulsion.
  • High-confidence television cases: Laal Ishq (“Dhruv, Sonya, Unhappy Pregnant Soul”), Naagin 3 and Sasural Simar Ka. Their episode recaps establish both pregnancy and possession, hypnosis, a spell or direct mental commands.
  • Close variant: Bandh Darwaza (1990). Neola hypnotizes and impregnates Lajo; the hypnosis occurs at conception rather than during an already-established pregnancy.
  • No naturalistic case verified: the search found no Indian plot in which a husband, doctor or criminal hypnotizes a pregnant woman for abortion, baby theft or revenge.
  • Regional-language gap: beyond the Marathi film Lapachhapi, targeted searches found no separate verified Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi television, Bhojpuri, Odia or Assamese title. Hindi serials dubbed into other languages are not counted twice.
Worldwide pregnant-woman control category

With the Indian and Indonesian updates, this category contains 19 high-confidence direct-control or possession cases and 18 close or medium-confidence variants. Every card labels the mechanism and the strength or limitation of its evidence.

  • High-confidence mechanisms: demonic possession, AI brainwashing, alien or embryo influence, an unborn parasite, a demon fetus, ghost possession, black magic and direct mental commands from an unborn entity.
  • Close and medium-confidence boundary: attempted possession, conception-time hypnosis, cult or medical reproductive coercion, supernatural pregnancy with ambiguous control, haunting or influence that stops short of clear possession, and single-source cases.
  • Regional entries: Help, Lapachhapi and Chhorii are the verified Indian film cases from the latest pass, while Iblis dalam Kandungan is the medium-high-confidence Indonesian attempted-possession case.
Pregnant-woman control: checked but excluded or unresolved

These titles surfaced in targeted searches but did not prove that the same woman was pregnant while her mind or actions were controlled.

  • Focused India exclusions: Birth confirms an eight-months-pregnant woman trapped by a sinister cult but not hypnosis, commanded acts or a mind-control mechanism. Nazar, Manmohini, Kavach, Naagin 5, Divya Drishti, Tantra and other checked serials fail the pregnancy-and-control overlap. Chhorii and Lapachhapi are now included because the newer source pass explicitly supports supernatural compulsion of pregnant women.
  • Other Indian non-fits: Jadu Tona, Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka!, Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara, Bhool Bhulaiyaa, Alpviram, Qayamat Ki Raat, Savdhaan India “Miseries of a Tormented Wife,” and other Laal Ishq hypnosis episodes did not establish successful mind control of a pregnant woman.
  • Indonesian screen titles: Sumala, Racun Sangga, Beranak dalam Kubur, Satu Suro, Kuyang, Hi5teria, Malam Jumat Kliwon, Dukun Beranak and the FTV Mendadak Hamil lack same-character pregnancy plus explicit mind control; Dukun is Malaysian and also splits pregnancy and possession between different women. The Womb / Inang has been moved into the strict section after newer scene-level evidence verified literal hypnosis during Wulan’s pregnancy.
  • Other unverified timing: Bunshinsaba has a possessed teacher who later gives birth, but pregnancy during possession could not be established.
  • Haunted or threatened, not controlled: Magi, The Wrath, The Unborn (2003), Ma and Sakanak. Cin Azabı is now retained only as a low-confidence unresolved lead, with its missing control evidence stated on the card.
  • Fetus affected or no overlap: Delivery: The Beast Within, Gauri: The Unborn, El maleficio and El extraño retorno de Diana Salazar.
  • No qualifying control: Xtro, Metamorphosis and several individually checked titles including Still/Born, Bed Rest, Apartment 7A, The Omen and The Last Exorcism Part II.
Pregnant mother + child walk-in: one airtight match (Catastrophe S2E1)

The 30 September 2026 English-indexed search and a follow-up using native-language queries across 12 priority markets established one airtight exact match — Catastrophe S2E1 (2015), in which deeply pregnant Sharon is mid-coitus with husband Rob when their son walks in — alongside one strongest candidate and 24 clearly labeled partial or exclusion cases, including 10 new catalog records from the follow-up; cards are displayed in ascending release-year order within each confidence group, with undated leads last.

  • Strongest candidate: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising (2016). Pregnancy, toddler Stella and the opening lovemaking scene are supported by multiple sources; Stella’s immediate entrance is stated explicitly in the IMDb plot summary and the associated adult-toy gag is corroborated by reviews. Because a screenplay, subtitles or direct scene check was not available, the exact timing remains unconfirmed and the title is not presented as a fully verified match.
  • Strongest new partial: СашаТаня (SashaTanya). Alyoshka’s bedroom walk-in is documented in Season 7, but Tanya’s verified twin pregnancy begins six episodes later in the Season 8 premiere; no pregnancy-period walk-in was found.
  • Native-language coverage: targeted searches covered Hindi, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, French, German, Russian and Italian. New partials from Russia, France, Argentina, Italy, Mexico, India, Turkey, Brazil and Japan remain labeled with the exact missing element.
  • Open questions: video, subtitle or transcript access is still needed to determine whether SashaTanya Season 8, Casados con hijos S01E89, Fais pas ci, fais pas ça Season 3 or Un medico in famiglia Season 2 contains a qualifying scene. Moni Argento’s pregnancy may also be a false alarm.
  • Not promoted: A Grande Família fails because Bebel’s pregnancy is her first. Four German or Russian walk-in clips have no pregnancy, so they remain outside the catalog rather than being padded into the partial list.
Child walks in on parents’ intimate scene: 39 sourced records

The category now holds 39 records: 23 shown strict cases involving the couple’s own minor child, four dialogue-confirmed childhood recollections, six adult-offspring cases and six labeled variants or near-misses. Descriptions remain non-graphic, and every card preserves the report’s confidence level and source caveat.

  • Strict shown cases: the own-child set is split by location. Bedroom or sleeping-room entries remain the strictest group; bathroom, living-room and couch interruptions are shown separately without losing their strict own-child status.
  • Recounted events: Veronica Mars, Scrubs, Yellowjackets and Misfits confirm a childhood walk-in through dialogue or transcript, but do not show the event on screen.
  • Adult offspring: Schitt’s Creek, Seinfeld, Life in Pieces, Psych, Titus and Friends are separated because the interrupter is an adult child.
  • Other variants: Soul Food uses a kitchen; Stepmom involves a father and future stepmother; Christmas Evil leaves the exact entry point unclear; South Park S20E04 uses a consensual kink act; F Is for Family has a child already hiding under the bed; and Once Upon a Time is post-coital rather than an interruption.
  • Worldwide result: Catastrophe S2E1 is the first verified pregnant-mother strict match in the catalog and has dual membership in the pregnancy-sex section. Pabbahelgar from Iceland remains the only verified non-English strict title found in the earlier walk-in sweep; its broader native-language searches produced unresolved leads rather than additional confirmed titles.
  • Unresolved, not promoted: exact episodes remain unidentified for Oliver Beene, Ready or Not, The Oblongs, Family Matters, The Drew Carey Show and 30 Rock. The French short Surprendre ses parents en train de... has IMDb-only support. Meet the Fockers remains a prior supplied adult-son lead without enough scene detail in this report, and the alleged Blockers stinger is contradicted by available material.
  • Firm exclusions: scenes with one parent and a different partner, a child merely overhearing from outside, an unrelated child, kissing only, averted interruptions or a reversed-direction setup are not included as matches.
Pregnant sex and intimate scenes: 18 new records after deduplication

The 30 September 2026 worldwide sweep expands both existing sections to 17 entries each. Eighteen unique records are new; Outlander, Yeh Hai Mohabbatein and Badhaai Ho were expanded in place rather than duplicated. Neon Bull and Knocked Up were independently reconfirmed and needed no structural change.

  • Having sex: the character is pregnant during an on-screen encounter, or the episode’s plot and sourcing clearly establish that it happened. Subgroups separate established partners, new partners or affairs, comedy, a plot-verified non-consensual case, adult-animation / sex-work context and one timing-caveat case.
  • Intimate scenes: attempted or interrupted sex, sensual or erotic imagery short of intercourse, affectionate non-sexual romance, labor-induction discussion, and sexual fantasy remain distinct from completed sex.
  • Evidence boundaries: A Happy Event rests on one English-language review after native-language searches did not corroborate the scene; The Housemaid, Junichi and Pasión de Gavilanes rely on viewer or fan sources; 24 Weeks verifies a sex scene but not the character’s pregnancy at that exact moment. These limits are repeated on the cards.
  • Held as near-misses: Bridal Shower only implies marital relations; Kızılcık Şerbeti does not establish overlap between the romantic episode and pregnancy arc. Other rejected leads either place the scene before pregnancy, only discuss sex, use a false or performer-only pregnancy, or lack a qualifying intimate scene.
  • Coverage gaps: no source-verified African or Arabic-language case was found, and none was verified in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, Punjabi, Pakistani, Bangladeshi or Sri Lankan productions. These are documentation gaps, not proof of absence.
  • Performer caveat: a performer being pregnant is not enough unless the character is also pregnant. Neon Bull remains separately labeled because both are true.
Category 4: mothers with children under hypnosis or mind control

The 30 September 2026 research pass found 17 higher-confidence fits and 12 separately labeled borderline or lower-confidence cases. The higher-confidence tier includes 16 English-language titles and one Spanish-language Argentine film. Every card states its mechanism and preserves source-level caveats; several obscure shorts rely only on IMDb synopsis-level evidence.

  • Strongest concentration: demonic-possession horror and witchcraft or technology-driven mind control.
  • Open leads: the Turkish/Indonesian Siccîn/Sijjin line still needs proof that the targeted wife is a mother with an on-screen child. Both versions of El maleficio need episode-level proof of direct mind control rather than deception or intimidation.
  • Research basis: indexed page content and fetched plot text; none of these findings was re-verified in a live research browser during this pass.
Category 4: regions and formats checked with no verified fit

Targeted searches found no additional verified fit in Indian regional cinema, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Thai or Filipino film and television; Brazilian/Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Scandinavian, Middle Eastern or African cinema; or Western animation.

  • India: Shaitaan and Vash control the daughter, not the mother.
  • Korea: Hypnotized (2004) involves a married woman, but motherhood was not verified.
  • Turkey: Dabbe: Cin Çarpması involves a possessed woman not established as a mother.
  • Other checked non-fits: Ouija: Origin of Evil, The Possession, The Exorcist, Get Out, The Manchurian Candidate, Mother Is Strong on Hypnotism, Mama, WandaVision, Bring Her Back, The Babadook, Relic and Bless the Child fail the mother-as-controlled-victim rule.
Worldwide expansion: 20 strong cases + 7 borderline

The 30 September 2026 worldwide pass added 20 defensible strong cases and 7 separately labeled borderline cases. Targeted searches covered the United States and Canada, Japan, South Korea, China, India, Latin America, Turkey and the Middle East, Russia/Soviet cinema, and continental Europe. The evidence supports fewer than the requested 40–60 new titles, so the catalog is not padded with weak matches.

  • New regional coverage is still concentrated in the United States and Japan. South Korea is represented by Hypnotized (2004), and China by The Love by Hypnotic (2019).
  • The Love by Hypnotic is supported by a MyDramaList review synopsis and TV Time synopsis, not a viewed transcript.
  • Tanken Driland and Yatterman episode 55 remain trope-index-only claims and are not catalog entries until independently verified.
Husband hypnotizes or mind-controls wife: dedicated worldwide pass

This source-index pass identified six strong movie matches, two TV-movie matches and one loose, unverified serial match. Its nine findings are included in the husband-control category and keep their direct, loose or unverified labels on the cards.

  • Strong movies: Amore e ipnotismo, Sleep, My Love, both versions of The Stepford Wives, Tee Ratra and Don’t Worry Darling.
  • TV movies: The Stepford Children is a direct match under the Stepford rule; Revenge of the Stepford Wives is loose because the town’s conspiracy—not Megan’s husband—imposes the conditioning.
  • Serial: 被催眠的她 (The Hypnotized Her) is loose and unverified because no source establishes that the husband is the hypnotist.
  • All findings in this pass rest on indexed page content reviewed 30 September 2026, not live-browser confirmation. The country and original language of Amore e ipnotismo remain unverified.
Checked and excluded from “hypnotized to love”
  • Shallow Hal (2001): the man’s perception is altered; no woman is hypnotized into love. RogerEbert.com
  • Get Out (2017): hypnosis enables the Coagula procedure, not romance. Get Out Wiki
  • Office Space (1999): Peter is hypnotized into job apathy; his romance is incidental. Wikipedia
  • Shaitaan (2024): occult control is possessive but not romantic. Tupaki
Checked and excluded from “husband controls wife”
  • Dr. Damon’s Experiment (1954, The Vise, UK): re-verification shows the husband hypnotizes his wife’s lover, not his wife.
  • Hypnotic (2021, USA): the hypnotherapist is not her husband.
  • Rosemary’s Baby (1968, USA): the husband drugs his wife, but the occult act is performed by the neighbors, not him.
  • Mesmerized (1985/86), Take Her by Surprise (1967), Perfect Little Angels (1998), The Stepford Husbands (1996), Possession (2009), The Hypnosis (2023), The Hypnotic Wife, Temptation of Wife (2008–09), and Night of the Eagle (1962) also miss the requested perpetrator–victim direction or use no hypnosis of the wife.
Titles and regions still unresolved
  • The Love Letter: the 1999 film uses a letter as a love-potion metaphor; the 1998 TV movie is a time-crossed correspondence story. A different intended title would need clarification. Boston Phoenix · IMDb
  • No verified Bollywood hypnosis-into-romance title or movie matching the single-mom-remarriage pattern was found.
  • Fantasy Island S04E06 surfaced, but no accessible plot summary confirmed a hypnosis-into-love story.
  • The earlier search found no confirmed soap-opera or telenovela match for this category. That finding is now superseded: El maleficio (1983–84), its 2023–24 remake, and Desejos de Mulher (2002) are the first confirmed telenovela matches.
  • The production country and original language of Amore e ipnotismo remain unverified.

sources.description: A worldwide research snapshot spanning films, serials, television movies, series, soap operas, individual episodes and short-form vertical dramas across sixty-three themes. The expanded index now includes a dedicated worldwide view of female characters hypnotized, brainwashed or magically controlled into agreeing to marriage, undergoing a wedding while controlled, or having children after such a marriage; a dedicated worldwide view of doctors and therapists who control female characters for sexual exploitation, crime cover-ups, programmed crime, financial or power gains, and possessive control; a dedicated worldwide view of polygamy plus pregnancy and depicted or reported intimate/sex scenes, separated into multiple-wife plots, royal-harem and concubine dramas, modern polygamous households, a polyandry variant and unresolved leads; it also retains the dedicated view of polygamy plus female hypnosis, mind control, possession, occult control or coercive indoctrination, separated into strict multiple-wife matches, concurrent-partner harem variants, cult variants, borderlines and related cross-references; adult/18+ works and unresolved cases are labeled plainly; and separates strict hypnosis during pregnancy from possession, therapeutic, cult, fetal-targeting and control-caused-pregnancy variants; gives non-pregnant Indian-language cases their own regional view; and includes women who knowingly or unknowingly bargain with a devil- or demon-coded force to become pregnant or have a child, with the pregnancy outcome stated; women hypnotized or mind-controlled by a husband, boyfriend, ex-husband or ex-boyfriend, with direct matches separated from third-party, occult, adult-audience and unresolved variants; adult-audience films and television in which hypnosis, possession or mind control overlaps a pregnancy or causes it; the worldwide adult-audience search for mothers controlled by a current husband or boyfriend; wives who are already mothers becoming pregnant by another man; partnered women hypnotized or mind-controlled into infidelity; the 180-entry worldwide adult-audience sweep of wives and other adult female characters subjected to hypnosis, mesmerism, hypnotic suggestion, erotic supernatural thrall or explicitly framed occult trance; wives and other female characters forcibly hypnotized into obedience; stepmothers or bonus moms hypnotized, possessed, cursed or enchanted against their will; pregnant stepmothers and bonus moms; the closest documented cases of a remarried wife controlled by her new husband or a stepfather figure; a pregnant single mother controlled by her new husband or child’s stepfather; pregnant women controlled by unborn, ghost or alien children; female characters controlled by children or teens; current wives controlled or possessed by a husband’s former wife or lover; wives hypnotized or controlled by therapists; parents being intimate while children sleep; the expanded worldwide index of children interrupting or witnessing their parents’ intimate moments; adoption followed by pregnancy; human-villain hypnosis; vampire mesmerism; demonic and occult control; spirit or djinn possession; tantrik and vashikaran plots; sci-fi control; cult brainwashing; therapeutic hypnosis; fantasy enchantment; and the expanded worldwide index of pregnant characters in sexual, sensual, romantic, attempted, labor-related or fantasy scenes.

sources.research_notes_html:
Boundaries & open questions

Female hypnotized into marriage: 23 memberships across three outcome buckets

The 3 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed about 180 search rounds across eight language, region and format vectors. Twenty-one findings are represented as distinct records, including four corrected entries that had previously been mistaken for existing records; two genuinely existing titles gained membership without duplicate cards.

  • Three plot buckets: A covers agreement to marriage under control; B covers a wedding performed while control is active; C tracks children after such a marriage. Titles that satisfy more than one bucket appear in each relevant subsection.
  • Mechanism honesty: literal trance, mesmerism, fantasy magic, hypnotic devices, implanted memories, drugs, cult coercion, occult ritual, djinn wishes and timeline rewriting are labeled separately.
  • Children after: only Eterna Magia verifies a child after the spell-driven marriage. A rumor about The Love by Hypnotic remains unconfirmed and is not counted.
  • Adult / erotic coverage: the dedicated adult and R-rated screen search returned no verified title. Two Japanese adult games found through the East Asian vector are included with 18+ labels and single-source caveats.
  • Held outside the category: The Devil’s Sonata lacks a verified marriage element; Kavach… Kaali Shaktiyon Se is possession during a wedding rather than control that causes the marriage; and O Beijo do Vampiro has confirmed hypnosis followed by pregnancy but no marriage, with paternity unresolved.
Female hypnosis deep sweep: 7 verified additions after full-catalog dedupe

The 2 October 2026 pass ran about 117 search rounds across mainstream vertical platforms, adult and erotic screen indexes, recent releases, smaller short-drama platforms and multilingual searches. Seven verified findings are now represented in their existing plot categories: two forced-obedience memberships and five hypno-intimacy memberships.

  • Vertical short: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees is the one new verified vertical drama. ReelShort’s official episode 6 page identifies the “Eyes of Rom” hypnosis beat involving Cathey; the card carries the vertical-short badge.
  • Memory-manipulation variant: O Hipnotizador S02E02 “Teresa e as Mariposas” is cross-filed into forced obedience, with the caveat that the episode concerns false-memory manipulation rather than a direct command.
  • 18+ explicit additions: The Hypnotist (1936), PPPD-305, Saimin Seishidou / Hypnosis Sex Guidance, Kyonyuu Onna Shikan Sennou Saimin and Saimin Jutsu the Animation 2nd are filed in hypno-intimacy. The two similarly named adult-animation titles are explicitly distinguished from the already-cataloged Kyonyuu Hitozuma Onna Kyoushi Saimin and Saimin Jutsu Zero.
  • Dedupe: four are net-new catalog records; three enrich existing rows. Eleven other researched titles were already represented and were not duplicated. Saimin (1999) remains excluded from female-victim categories because the documented hypnosis victims are male.
  • Unresolved leads: 17 LOW-confidence or title-only leads remain outside the catalog, including My Childhood Friend Hypnotized Me To Love Another, several unidentified dubbed edits and adult listings without enough plot-level support.
  • Honest zeros: no additional adult-only vertical short was verified on the legitimate platforms searched; post-1 October releases, the reviewed obscure-platform indexes and the additional language corners also returned no net-new verified title.
Doctor controls female characters for personal gain: 20 verified findings, 7 existing-record overlaps

The 2 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed films, television series and episodes, daytime soaps, telenovelas and adult animation across seven regional and format vectors. Twenty verified findings are grouped by motive; seven already-cataloged titles receive category membership without duplicate records.

  • Five motive groups: 4 sexual-exploitation findings; 5 crime cover-up, silencing or framing stories; 5 cases where a patient is programmed to commit crimes; 4 money, inheritance or power grabs; and 2 romantic or possessive-control stories.
  • Confidence: 13 findings are high confidence and 7 medium. The 17 low-confidence leads are not filed.
  • Mechanism honesty: cards distinguish classical trance from implanted chips, drugs, gaslighting, psychiatric conditioning, machine mind-control, non-trance manipulation, memory alteration and fantasy hypnosis.
  • Special flags: adult and erotic works, female doctors, the 19-year-old patient in Augustine, school settings, a non-doctor counsellor edge and the teen-victim caveat on the 2025 Thai Hypnotic remain explicit.
  • Cross-filing: qualifying sexual-exploitation cases also appear in the adult female-hypnosis doctor/therapist group and the hypnotized-intimacy view; supported forced-obedience cases are cross-filed without creating extra records.
  • Coverage limits: the sweep found no verified additions in Indian cinema or television, short-form vertical dramas, several African and Middle Eastern markets, UK soaps, or the reviewed golden-age explicit-adult and Hong Kong Category III indexes. These are research results, not proof that no other case exists.
Pregnant-woman hypnosis sweep: 1 strict update, 4 new variants or leads

The 2–3 October 2026 worldwide sweep ran 110 query rounds across 13+ languages, covering vertical-short platforms, mainstream film and television, and adult / R-rated indexes. Five catalog updates are retained after full-catalog dedupe: one existing Indonesian film gains strict-core membership, and four new mainstream film or television records join the variants-and-leads view.

  • Strict core: The Womb / Inang (2022) now records that Eva hypnotizes pregnant Wulan into agreeing to stay until after delivery. Two independent plot explainers support the pregnancy-era hypnosis; the card remains medium confidence.
  • Supported supernatural variants: Djinn (2013) and Alkarısı Cinnet (2015) are medium-confidence possession or haunting cases, not literal hypnosis. Their cards state the exact mechanism gap.
  • Unresolved leads: Cin Azabı has an unverified year and does not establish will-override; سحر أسود / Sehr El Aswad confirms a black-magic series but not a pregnant controlled victim. Both remain LOW-confidence leads.
  • Held outside the catalog: Ezedike / The Pregnant Witches is not filed because its pregnant women appear to be agents of unseen forces rather than controlled victims, and no mind-control mechanism is confirmed.
  • Honest zeros: no strict match was verified on the vertical-short platforms searched; no new verified hypno-intimacy or adult / R-rated title survived. In-app-only titles and some native-language platform searches remain an access gap, not proof of absence.
  • Dedupe: Birth, Vashikaranam – Kis Par Rakhe Vishwas, Saimin Seishidou, The Interns S1E17 (previously tracked as “Metamorphosis”) and Karishika were already represented and were not added again.
Polygamy + pregnancy + intimate / sex scenes: 99 worldwide findings

The 1–2 October 2026 worldwide sweep reviewed films, television series and serials, TV movies, soap operas, historical dramas and vertical shorts across ten regional and format vectors. It found 99 distinct titles or leads and grouped them by how closely all three plot elements are documented.

  • Multiple wives / partners with pregnancy: 33 records, including 10 high-confidence strict matches. Formal co-wives, bigamy, live-in parallel households and edge cases such as a mistress or sequential-marriage overlap are distinguished on each card.
  • Royal harem / concubine stories: 29 records, including 11 high-confidence titles and one medium-high title. Nine palace dramas remain low confidence because pregnancy and plural-consort structures are established but intimacy is only implied or off-screen.
  • Modern polygamous households: 8 records spanning HBO drama, Indonesian cinema, Lifetime TV movies, a fantasy-series subplot and vertical drama. Missing pregnancy or intimacy evidence is stated rather than inferred.
  • Polyandry variant: Matrubhoomi: A Nation Without Women is separated from polygyny and carries a prominent sexual-violence caveat; it is not framed as romantic polyandry.
  • Unresolved leads: 28 records remain clearly labeled because pregnancy, depicted intimacy, formal plural-marriage status, release identity or another required element is not yet verified.
  • Adult / R-rated / erotic coverage: the dedicated vector found 12 relevant adult-audience or explicit candidates, including The Concubine, Jan Dara, Versailles, Borgia and The Golden Lotus: Love and Desire. Hardcore pornography was outside the research scope.
  • Dedupe: this category reuses existing catalog rows where the same title and release year were already present, adding a category-specific view instead of a second card.
Polygamy + female hypnosis / mind control: 36 category memberships, 6 unresolved leads

The 1 October 2026 worldwide sweep and strict-scope supplement searched films, television series and serials, TV movies, soap operas, anime, documentaries and adult-audience productions across fourteen complementary regional and format vectors. The catalog now shows 33 supported or borderline research titles plus three related existing records, without adding duplicate rows.

  • Five plot-pattern groups: 10 strict core matches connect plural wives or consorts to hypnosis, possession or occult will-override; 6 harem variants involve concurrent controlled partners rather than wives; 8 cult variants document coercive indoctrination, not literal hypnosis; 9 entries are labeled borderline; and 3 related records are cross-referenced from existing catalog rows.
  • Adult / 18+ coverage: adult, softcore and mature-audience records are explicitly labeled. The worldwide search also covered R-rated and erotic cinema.
  • New strict-core coverage: the supplement adds the 2005 Trapped by the Mormons remake, Egypt’s ساحرة الجنوب / Saherat El Ganoub, India’s Sasural Simar Ka, China’s Creation of the Gods I: Kingdom of Storms and Japan’s Genji Monogatari: Sennen no Nazo. O Beijo do Vampiro now records its confirmed plural-wife dimension while keeping the separate pregnancy-era hypnosis timing question open.
  • Honest-zero searches: the strict review found no additional verified combination in modern European productions, Western soaps, Turkish erotic films, Scandinavian / Eastern European / Oceanian cinema, Iranian titles, most imperial-harem dramas, or the dedicated Latin America / Africa and adult-erotic vectors. These are documentation results, not proof that no other title exists.
  • Unresolved leads — not counted as verified: The 19th Wife (2010), Escape from Polygamy (2013), Hell Is Empty (2021/22), Sharara / شرارة (2026), RadhaKrishn (2018–2023) and an unidentified Thai lakorn. For Sharara, the only located promo describes sihr aimed at the husband rather than a woman, and episode-level confirmation is still missing.
  • Explicit exclusions: Big Love, Sister Wives, The Polygamist (2026), O Clone / El Clon, The Stepford Wives, Get Out, El Maleficio (1983), Shaitaan, Vash, Caminhos do Coração, Bible Black, Queen Seondeok and Kutsujoku fail one prong, reverse the control direction or lack a qualifying plural-wife structure.
DramaExpress + short-drama-sites sweep (1 Oct 2026): 7 net-new titles, 4 leads, ~48 exclusions

The sweep covered 12 platform surfaces: dramaexpress.net, DramaBox, ReelShort, GoodShort, ShortMax and ShortTV, NetShort, DramaWave, FlexTV, ToonShort, Miralune Short and MiniShorts. Seven net-new titles were verified: three forced-obedience entries, three age-gap-marriage entries and one mom-pregnancy borderline/variant.

  • LOW leads: four were reviewed. 寒途向新生, My Don Missed My Last Chance to Be a Mother and A Lover's Trap are filed only as clearly labeled unresolved leads, not as verified entries. The Tower That Erased Me is excluded: NetShort describes Chloe being suppressed with antipsychotics in a psychiatric facility, which is chemical sedation rather than hypnosis.
  • Exclusions: roughly 48 candidates were rejected because they used a werewolf mate-bond genre trope rather than hypnosis, ordinary amnesia, telepathy, a plain secret-baby plot, or devil romance without pregnancy.
  • Honest zeros: strict pregnant-while-hypnotized, devil-deal pregnancy, hypno-intimacy plus pregnancy and adult / R-rated / 18+ productions each returned zero; all 12 platforms skew PG-13 / Teen.
  • Coverage limits: no live browser was available, so in-app-only titles remained unreachable. Miralune Short and MiniShorts have no text-searchable web catalogs, while dramaexpress.net is new (about September 2026) and has minimal search-engine indexing.
Pregnant + hypnotized round 2: no new strict-core title; two variant outcomes

The 1 October 2026 super-deep sweep covered seven regional vectors across movies, television, serials, soap operas, anime and adult-audience plot indexes. It found no net-new title meeting the strict rule that the same adult woman is pregnant while an external force overrides her will.

  • New close variant: Don't Turn Around, or You'll Be Sorry / 唔該借歪 (2000) is filed in both the evil-force and pregnancy-control-variant views. Five sources describe a ghost seeking to take over pregnant Lisa's body, but the takeover is framed as attempted or thwarted rather than completed.
  • Re-identified lead: the old “Metamorphosis” record is now correctly The Interns S1E17 (1971), a CBS television episode. Pregnancy and episode identity are corroborated, while the diagnostic-hypnosis detail remains single-sourced.
  • Corrections: Alem-i Cin 4's pregnant character is İrem, not İpek; Turkish sources confirm the pregnancy, but not literal will-override. Saimin Seishidou's “pregnancy experience” is now labeled simulated, not real. Danger Diva's source list was reconciled without adding a duplicate.
  • Revisit list — not catalog records: Pregnancy (Nigeria); Zir-i Cin 4: Nesep Bağı (2026); Üç Harfliler: Mühür (2026); Fear Files S3E9; 418 (Telugu, theatrical release dated 23 October 2026); the unresolved Nollywood demon-pregnancy video; and Revolving Heart / 心门 (2017), which still needs a third source and fails strict simultaneity.
  • Coverage gaps: IAFD direct search remained unavailable; Scandinavian and deeper European adult-index passes were not completed; documentation remains thin for several South and Southeast Asian markets. These are search gaps, not claims that no additional title exists.
Pregnant belly kissed or touched by kids: 7 verified family-warmth scenes

The first 1 October 2026 worldwide sweep filed six verified scenes after dedupe. A round-2 deep sweep across six vectors adds one medium-confidence human-character scene, bringing this view to seven records.

  • Round-2 addition: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings shows Ying Li resting young Shang-Chi on her pregnant stomach in a flashback. The card retains the fan-curated-source and visibility caveats.
  • Round-1 records retained: Kim Possible: A Sitch in Time, A Separation, the Vietnamese-titled NetShort series Đuổi Tôi Đi, Giờ Đòi Nhận Con?, Pan's Labyrinth / El laberinto del fauno, Look Who's Talking Too and Parenthood.
  • NetShort enrichment: the child is now identified as Elowen Thorne's own son Elian; the werewolf-romance premise, still-unidentified original title, official-thumbnail verification and possible pregnant-again overlap are recorded on the existing card.
  • Scope refinement: round-2 animal, animated-animal and animal-puppet findings were not filed. Existing round-1 records were left unchanged.
  • Coverage result: the dedicated adult / erotic vector returned an honest structural zero.
Hallmark six-topic sweep: 11 titles filed across four views

The 1 October 2026 sweep reviewed Hallmark Channel, Hallmark Mystery, Hallmark+, and the Crown Media / Hallmark Hall of Fame back catalog across six requested plot patterns. It adds ten net-new records and upgrades one existing record, Jane Doe: How to Fire Your Boss, without duplication.

  • Pregnant female character: eight titles appear in the new Hallmark-specific view. Seven are high confidence; Signed, Sealed, Delivered: A Tale of Three Letters is medium confidence because pregnancy is announced only in the final moments.
  • Mother pregnant again: Three Wisest Men follows Sophie, already mother to Thomas, while expecting twins.
  • Remarriage: Love's Enduring Promise is a core fit, though the pregnancy occurs off-screen between films. Love Comes Softly is a labeled borderline because Marty is already pregnant by her late husband before marrying Clark.
  • Female hypnosis: the existing Jane Doe: How to Fire Your Boss record is upgraded to high confidence and cross-filed into forced obedience for its trigger-word sleeper-agent trance.
  • Honest zeroes: no Hallmark title was verified for a pregnant woman hypnotized while pregnant or a remarried woman who is hypnotized. Competing-network lookalikes and unproduced pitches remain excluded.
Vertical short dramas: 13 mothers become pregnant again

The 1 October 2026 multilingual sweep adds 13 deduplicated vertical-short records to the mother-pregnancy view. The English HoneyReels title Two Babies in One Birth: Daddy, Mummy is Pregnant Again and the Mandarin 一胎两宝：爹地妈咪又怀了 share the same cast and are therefore one record.

  • Visible-pregnancy evidence: For the Custody, I Slept with a Billionaire has direct episode-level baby-bump wording. They Locked Her Daughter in the Car, A Baby, a Billionaire, And Me and CEO Wants My Little Rascal have medium-strength anchors through emergency labor, belly-touching and maternity shopping, or on-screen ultrasound and pregnancy-test scenes.
  • Scope caveats retained: Unconditionally Loved by the Lycan Billionaire has mixed DramaBox / Stardust TV attribution. 诞下二胎，父母破局 and Ditch The Mommy Duties After Reborn involve adult daughters, while Reborn At Sixty, I'm Pregnant Again is an elderly-mother rebirth fantasy.
  • Held outside the catalog: Beg Me, My Mafia Ex-Husband remains unfiled because the available synopsis does not establish the parentage or timing of “her child” relative to the new pregnancy. The titleless 借种怀二胎 upload and all other unresolved leads also remain unfiled pending a verified title or stronger plot evidence. The visible-pregnancy follow-up found no additional net-new title meeting its screen-evidence bar.
Vertical short dramas: 8 verified hypnosis titles, including 2 strict pregnancy-era matches

The 1 October 2026 hypnosis-and-pregnancy sweeps found seven titles for the broad hypnotized-to-love / relationship-role view. A separate five-vector female-hypnosis sweep reviewed roughly 70 additional query rounds and adds Stay Away! She's a Violent Psycho! to the forced-obedience view. Snake Year Salvation: CEO's Bargain Bride and I Accidentally Had the Billionaire's Twins also qualify for the strict pregnant-while-hypnotized category.

  • New forced-obedience addition: Stay Away! She's a Violent Psycho! is a medium-high-confidence NetShort drama of approximately 80 episodes. Mr. Jensen uses Dr. Clark to hypnotize Jessie Bennett for control and punishment; episode 58 shows Jessie resisting the pocket-watch attempt, while episode 61 says six years of torture left her immune to hypnosis. The release year and exact episode count remain unconfirmed.
  • Strict pregnancy-era overlap: Snake Year Salvation has adjacent episode-guide evidence for the heroine carrying a baby and being hypnotized with a pocket watch. I Accidentally Had the Billionaire's Twins places Kathy's kidnapping and hypnosis after a marker identifying her as pregnant and before the six-year jump; its pregnancy timing is inferred from those markers and remains medium-high confidence.
  • Follow-up love-category addition: Broken Bone Rose is a medium-confidence Mandarin vertical drama in which a man erases his bodyguard's memories through hypnosis to keep her. Two independent uploads support the mechanism and direction, but the year and episode count remain unconfirmed.
  • Pregnancy timing unresolved: Sweet Strategy: Mr. Vance's Ex Is Too Proud links the hypnosis incident to a later pregnancy discovery, but does not establish whether Elena was already pregnant during the hypnosis.
  • Other verified female-control titles: Twisted Vows pairs hypnosis with a forced new identity and fiancée role; They Called Me the Fake Heiress, But My Birthright Was Far Greater uses pill-assisted hypnosis to impose false “rebirth” memories; and Taste of the Wild uses chime-based mind control, with a retained Emma/Rachel name discrepancy and mixed controller direction.
  • Resolved exclusions and open leads: 被催眠的她 / Hypnotized Her is rejected because the plot attributes the wife's perceptions to mental illness, not literal hypnosis. Scratch Your Fate episode 59 is rejected because Olivia is the hypnotizer and her pregnancy is only alleged. My Childhood Friend Hypnotized Me To Love Another, 被束缚后她觉醒了, and unidentified YouTube edits remain outside the catalog pending corroboration.
  • Coverage result: the separate female-hypnosis sweep found no additional verified title in its Chinese-vertical, Asia-regional, Latin America / EMEA or recap-aggregator vectors. Search indexing remains weak for several platforms, so those are documented search zeroes, not proof that no other title exists.
Hypnotized to marry or love: worldwide max sweep, including short-form vertical dramas

The 1 October 2026 sweep reviewed 16 candidates across eight multilingual research vectors and roughly 150 query rounds. After reconciling the finished sweep against the current catalog, two records are net-new and four existing records are cross-filed into this plot category without duplicating them.

  • Net-new: Kiss Me, Even If It Burns is the key DramaBox-style vertical short-series find; billionaire Dylan Pitt erases bodyguard Scarlet Novak’s memories so she will fall in love with him anew. Eternally Yours verifies a hypnosis scheme to win back an ex-wife, but the reconciliation outcome remains unconfirmed.
  • New category memberships: The current catalog already held The Brides of Dracula, so its vampiric mesmerism toward a devoted “bride” bond and interrupted forced marriage is cross-filed rather than duplicated. The Kiss of the Vampire transfers Marianne’s devotion from her husband to Ravna; She Did What He Wanted compels adult Nora’s “loving” devotion without marriage; and Naagin 3 hypnotizes Bela toward divorce and an interrupted nikah with Shahnawaz.
  • Already covered: Road to Rio, both Flash Gordon versions, Devil Doll, Carefree, Don’t Go Breaking My Heart, El maleficio 2, The Hypnotist (1911), and Skin Deep in Love.
  • Excluded: How to Be Very, Very Popular (1955) remains outside the catalog because its accidental hypnosis is incidental to the romance. MENA/Africa/Russia and East/Southeast Asia produced no net-new verified title in this pass; those are documentation results, not proof that none exist.
Woman bargains with the devil or a demon for pregnancy / a child: 9 core matches + 1 failed-deal variant + 11 unresolved leads

The 30 September 2026 multilingual sweeps now support nine core records: six knowing feature-film cases, one knowing short and two unknowing fertility schemes. A high-confidence episode in which both fertility rituals fail is separated as a variant, and eleven thinner or structurally adjacent leads are not counted as verified core matches. Every card states the pregnancy outcome and the evidence caveat.

  • New verified additions: Pengabdi Setan / Satan's Slaves and Soulful are high confidence; Exorcismo Negro is medium-high confidence with a witch-mediated devil link; and the erotic-horror film Secta Sinestra / Bloody Sect is a medium-confidence tricked fertility-clinic case.
  • Failed-deal variant: American Horror Story: Coven “Boy Parts” is high confidence on plot, but Cordelia's paid and sex-magic fertility rituals do not result in pregnancy. The counterparty is practitioner Marie Laveau rather than the devil directly.
  • Source discrepancies retained: The Surrogate now says “pregnancy outcome ambiguous” because its pre-production pitch says she cannot get pregnant while release loglines say she struggles to stay pregnant. The American Horror Stories “BA'AL” card now records that Liv's husband faked the haunting; only the final beat suggests the real Ba'al may take hold.

boundaries: 6 Oct 2026 ultrasound × hypnosis intersection sweep: six research lanes searched English, Latin American / Iberian, South Asian, East / Southeast Asian, European / MENA, adult / erotic and vertical-microdrama sources. The intersection is genuinely near-empty: 1 source-supported record was added and 3 existing records were enriched.

Inclusion caveats: Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka! hypnotizes Rehan rather than pregnant Roshni; Art of the Devil reverses the control direction because Boom commissions the ritual magic; Rosemary’s Baby (2014) uses cult gaslighting and manipulation rather than literal hypnosis. Daayan is the strongest direct scan-to-hypnosis match.

Not promoted: Unter uns and Demain nous appartient have hypnosis and pregnancy but no sourced ultrasound scene; 25 verified near-misses and 4 unverified leads remain outside the catalog. The Handmaid’s Tale season 2 is borderline institutional indoctrination rather than hypnosis, and Ultrasound (2021) has no verifiable sonogram scene despite its title.

Intersection coverage gaps remain for poorly indexed anthology episodes, Burmese-language sources, episode-level Turkish / Arabic serials and app-only microdramas. Dedicated adult / erotic passes found no verifiable title combining a pregnancy scan with hypnosis, love-potion or qualifying control; possession-only stories were excluded.

5 Oct 2026 pregnancy-ultrasound sweep: 84 confirmed scene-level records across 9 categories. The 107 near-misses remain excluded, and 13 titles already present elsewhere in the catalog were not added again.

Ultrasound coverage: 12 languages and four formats (59 TV-series records, 22 movies, 2 soap operas and 1 TV movie). Latin American research produced 19 records, with fake-pregnancy fraud the dominant pattern; Indian research found no prenatal-sex-determination reveal, consistent with the PCPNDT Act prohibition.

Ultrasound gaps for a future pass: Japanese and Chinese drama, Scandinavian and German television, Arabic and Persian fiction, and pornographic-industry titles. The Good Doctor episode numbering remains uncertain, and The Pregnancy Project is the weakest confirmed inclusion.

Nine existing catalog records were cross-checked as ultrasound overlaps: Superstore, Coronation Street, Emmerdale, Days of Our Lives, General Hospital, The Young and the Restless, Un medico in famiglia, Sasural Simar Ka and Knocked Up. They remain single records rather than duplicates; the supplied merge packet did not include scene-level overlap synopses or direct overlap source links.

5 Oct 2026 surrogate sweep: a worldwide nine-lane search found 1 confirmed and 2 probable records, with 24+ near-misses ruled out. The trope is nearly nonexistent worldwide; India, Latin America / Spanish-Portuguese, Turkey / MENA, adult / erotic worldwide and vertical-short lanes returned no qualifying title.

Surrogate-sweep caveats: Days of Our Lives combines chemical control concurrent with Marlena’s surrogacy and separate later hypnosis / brainwashing arcs; The Young and the Restless places Mariah’s reported brainwashing about four years after her surrogacy and leaves the controller’s presence ambiguous; Toni, männlich, Hebamme is a borderline coercive domestic-control case, not literal hypnosis.

5 Oct 2026 re-sweep: eight source-supported records were added and Sleep, My Love (1948) was folded into the rich-woman money / inheritance category without duplication. Two October theatrical titles were still upcoming at research time, and Hypnotized Bride remains explicitly probable because only one licensed short-drama channel supports its plot.

Wife-takes-husband-to-hypnotist follow-up: no new qualifying title was found. Holiday Hypnosis (2005) and Edison’s Mesmerist and Country Couple (1899) were confirmed only as non-qualifying near-misses; the Chinese vertical short The Hypnotized Her was held out because the required plot turn could not be verified.

Vertical-short coverage gap: searches covered ReelShort, DramaBox, FlexTV, ShortMax, NetShort, DramaWave, Chinese mini-programs and social-video serials, but app catalogs remain poorly discoverable. Only one eligible single-source vertical-short candidate was added, so this is a coverage limitation rather than an absence claim; a dedicated app-catalog pass remains open.

Partner-to-hypnotist switched-target pattern: the worldwide search found no exact match. “The Hypnotist” (1936), in which both spouses are hypnotized, and “How to Be Very, Very Popular” (1955), in which a woman is hypnotized instead of an intended male target, are both loose matches because neither available synopsis establishes that she brought a male partner for his treatment. The other 13 reviewed titles are retained only as clearly labeled non-qualifying near-misses.

Two additional leads remain unverified because plot sources were insufficient: the Mexican film “El hipnotizador / The Hypnotist” (1940) and the German comedy “Hypnotisiert” (IMDb tt0658815). Targeted searches found no qualifying titles in Indian regional cinema, European film beyond the listed cases, Latin American telenovelas, Korean/Japanese/Chinese dramas or Turkish dizis.

Woman bargains with the devil or a demon for pregnancy / a child: 9 core matches + 1 failed-deal variant + 11 unresolved leads. 9 core (6 knowing feature films, 1 short, 2 unknowing fertility schemes); “Pengabdi Setan / Satan’s Slaves” and “Soulful” high; “Exorcismo Negro” medium-high; “Secta Sinestra” medium tricked case; “AHS: Coven” “Boy Parts” failed-deal variant; exclusions: “Rosemary’s Baby”, “Devil’s Due”, “The First Omen”, “Pari”, “Impetigore”, “AHS: Delicate”.

Pregnant sexual pleasure scenes: 5 verified additions from a worldwide sweep — “Catastrophe” S2E1, “A Frozen Flower”, “Los días que vendrán”, “How to Plan an Orgy in a Small Town”, “The Pregnant Widow”; 18 borderlines + 81 near-misses reviewed; not promoted: “Titane”, “Jamón, jamón”, “Rosemary Is Pregnant Again”.

Partner hires a third party to hypnotize or mind-control wife / girlfriend: 4 verified — motives and honest-zero regions (Latin America/Spain, MENA/Turkey, Europe, Japan, Chinese markets, Thailand, Indonesia, sub-Saharan Africa, adult/erotic indexes).
Female controlled by husband, boyfriend or ex-partner: direct matches, variants and honest zeroes — unified view; ex-husband: zero verified (“Desejos de Mulher” near-miss); ~91 near-misses reviewed.

Husband secretly gets his wife pregnant: 1 lead — Filipino film “Anak, Asawa, At Ina” (1972), marked Pregnant Wife in a Searchlight catalog; plot line not located.

Pregnant woman hypnotized by child: no exact case located; partials — “Village of the Damned” 1995 (alien children control adults), “The Midwich Cuckoos” 2022, “Fear Her” (2006), “The Stranger Within” (fetus/alien entity), “The Unborn” (1991), “Mushishi” episode 21. Checked and excluded from “hypnotized to love”: “Shallow Hal” (2001), “Get Out” (2017), “Office Space” (1999), “Shaitaan” (2024).

Checked and excluded from “husband controls wife”: “Dr. Damon’s Experiment” (1954), “Hypnotic” (2021), “Rosemary’s Baby” (1968), “Mesmerized”, “Take Her by Surprise”, “Perfect Little Angels”, “The Stepford Husbands”, “Possession” (2009), “The Hypnosis” (2023), “The Hypnotic Wife”, “Temptation of Wife” (2008–09), “Night of the Eagle” (1962).

Titles and regions still unresolved: “The Love Letter” 1999 vs 1998; no Bollywood hypnosis-into-romance; “Fantasy Island” S04E06; telenovela matches now confirmed: “El maleficio” original/remake and “Desejos de Mulher”; “Amore e ipnotismo” country/language unverified.

Rich-woman hypnosis / love-potion sweep: 16 accepted entries across six motive groups. The requested 30-plus target was not reachable without padding, so the catalog stops at the 16 source-supported entries and does not promote the near-miss list.

Rich-woman sweep caveats: “Interactive” still needs direct verification of the head doctor’s erotic motive; “Thirteen Women” needs wealth confirmation beyond Laura Stanhope; “Huwad”, “Amore e ipnotismo” and “Tee Ratra” retain explicit wealth uncertainty. “Secrets of the French Police” centers on supposed royal wealth rather than an actually rich victim, and “The Return of Richard Neal” only implies comfort.

Rich-woman sweep coverage: no verified entries were found for Latin America, East Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Oceania, Eastern Europe or Russia. Pre-1930 non-US silent cinema, 1970s–80s European sexploitation and short-form vertical dramas remain under-searched; four open leads were not promoted.

entries.title: The Curse of the Jade Scorpion
entries.confidence_flag: High confidence · partner is a lover, not a husband or fiancé
entries.summary: Voltan hypnotizes Betty Ann Fitzgerald and C.W. Briggs into believing they are newlyweds madly in love; the implanted romance drives the film’s central comic setup. entries.title: Yeh Hai Mohabbatein
entries.subtitle: Shagun possession track
entries.mechanism: Spirit / ghost / djinn possession · Ex-wife spirit possession
entries.confidence_flag: Research report · web-verified · High confidence
entries.summary: Shagun's ghost enters Ishita and controls her; she is described as "hypnotized by Shagun's ghost." Ex-wife/ex-lover category detail: After Raman Bhalla’s ex-wife Shagun dies by suicide, her spirit repeatedly possesses Raman’s current wife Ishita and takes full control of her body. Possessed Ishita calls herself “Shagun maa,” attacks Raman, flirts with Ashok and forces the vegetarian Ishita to eat chicken on Karva Chauth. Pregnant-stepmother arc: Dentist Ishita Iyer marries divorced father Raman Kumar Bhalla to secure custody of his daughter Ruhi and also mothers his son Aditya. In 2015 she becomes pregnant with Raman’s child, a celebrated pregnancy beat that ends in miscarriage after an accident caused by Ashok Khanna. During the pregnancy track, Raman hugs Ishita when the positive test is revealed, says “I love you,” imagines their baby’s future with her, and later pampers her and serves milk in bed.

xla62ucxbx02u5:833.s: Per the user's report (2026-10-01), in this Telugu film directed by Vijayendra Prasad (starring Srikanth, Venu, Ramya Krishna, Gowri Munjal) the husband pays a hypnotist to hypnotize his wife. This plot point is UNVERIFIED and contradicts the published record: every plot synopsis found describes a bigamy comedy — Venkateshwarulu (Venu) wants two wives at his grandmother's insistence, Indu (Gowri Munjal) agrees in order to teach him a lesson, and her 'first husband' (Srikanth) turns up — with no hypnotist anywhere in the story. The sole hypnotism element in any source is a NowRunning review line praising comedy bits between comedians Ali and Venu Madhav based on hypnotism.

entries.title: American Horror Stories
entries.subtitle: Season 1, episode 5 · “BA'AL”
entries.meta: TV anthology episode · United States · English · FX on Hulu
entries.mechanism: Unknowing fertility ritual; later knowing bargain
entries.confidence_flag: High confidence · first pregnancy YES · second outcome AMBIGUOUS
entries.summary: After five failed IVF rounds, Liv accepts a Ba'al fertility statue from a clinic receptionist and unknowingly uses it during intimacy in hope of conception. She becomes pregnant and gives birth to Aaron. In the final beat, now knowingly bound to the real Ba'al, she offers to release him if he gives her “another baby”; the episode ends before that second outcome is shown.
entries.provenance: Source sites cited in the 30 Sep 2026 worldwide sweep: thewrap.com, screenrant.com and americanhorrorstory.fandom.com/wiki/BA'AL.
entries.note: Caveat: Liv's husband faked the apparent haunting as a gaslighting scheme. Only the final beat suggests that the real Ba'al may take hold, which makes the episode a two-stage hoax / possible-supernatural case rather than an uninterrupted demonic bargain plot.

entries.title: Aquí no hay quien viva
entries.subtitle: Bea with Rosa, then with Ana
entries.confidence_flag: High · academic article (UCM 2019) + TV Tropes
entries.summary: Vet Bea, 33, wants to be a mother and, after adoption falls through, gets pregnant using her gay friend Mauri as donor (ch. 30). While pregnant she starts dating Rosa, and she gives birth in ch. 42 while with Rosa, who fights Mauri over the 'father' role. Later Bea's partner Ana decides to carry; a mix-up means she inseminates with Mariano's sperm instead of Fernando's, gets pregnant and miscarries (ch. 83).
entries.character: Couples: Bea (Eva Isanta) and Rosa (María Almudéver); later Bea and Ana (Vanesa Romero)
entries.provenance: Lesbian-couple pregnancy research pass, 30 Sep 2026 (adult couples only; non-explicit notes)
entries.note: Outcome facts: pregnancy outcome: gives birth (Bea); miscarriage (Ana); kids status: yes (for Ana's pregnancy).
entries.pregnancy_note: Bea gives birth in chapter 42; Ana's pregnancy ends in miscarriage in chapter 83.
entries.pregnant_has_children: no for Bea; yes for Ana (co-mother of Bea's baby)

episodes.gist: Bea becomes pregnant using Mauri as a known donor.
Rosa and Mauri argue over who gets the 'father' role.
Bea gives birth while dating Rosa.
Bea and Ana ask Fernando to donate sperm.
After a mix-up Ana is pregnant by Mariano's sperm and miscarries.

entries.kids_note: No children when Bea conceives. When Ana conceives, Bea already has her baby, so Ana carries as a bonus mom: the second pregnancy in Bea's relationships.
entries.fit_note: Bea was single when she conceived and met Rosa while pregnant.
entries.pregnancy_again_note: after Bea's birth, partner Ana's pregnancy ends in miscarriage (ch. 83)

entries.confidence_flag: Episode cross-checked (Wikipedia, TheTVDB, IMDb, CBSC); sources differ on whether sex is shown or implied
entries.summary: In S1E15 “The Mesmerizer” (first aired 7 Jan 1998 on Showtime), quack hypnotist Dr. Edgar Thurlow gains strong hypnotic power from the cursed gun. The wife of a dying, much older wealthy man has Thurlow hypnotize her husband to ease his pain; during the session she also falls into a trance, and Thurlow makes her undress and be drawn to him while her husband sits entranced nearby. One source says sex occurs; the CBSC ruling says only undressing and brief nudity are shown, with sex implied. Later Thurlow keeps the dying man in a trance between life and death (a Poe “Valdemar”-style plot), and it ends badly for Thurlow.

entries.summary: While Callie and Arizona are apart, Callie gets pregnant by Mark Sloan; Arizona comes back and the three agree to co-parent. Callie and premature baby Sofía recover so mother and baby can meet.

entries.title: Hospital Central
entries.subtitle: Maca and Esther (Telecinco)
entries.confidence_flag: High · academic article + press
entries.summary: Pediatrician Maca and nurse Esther have three children in their relationship. Maca carries the first (Pedro) by artificial insemination with an anonymous donor, after failing to find a known donor. Esther then gets pregnant by SAMUR doctor Raúl in an affair, and Maca forgives her (Patricia). Patricia has Fanconi anaemia, so their youngest, Paula, is conceived by insemination with Raúl's sperm as a bone-marrow match.
entries.character: Couple: Maca Wilson (Patricia Vico) and Esther García (Fátima Baeza)

entries.title: Days of Our Lives — Marlena Evans (surrogate for Rex & Cassie; Stefano captivity + Andre DiMera brainwashing)
entries.meta: Daytime soap opera · United States · English · NBC / Peacock
entries.summary: Comatose Marlena, held by Stefano DiMera on his island, was used as a surrogate for the genetically engineered twins Rex and Cassie, whose biological parents are Roman Brady and Kate Roberts. Stefano kept her mostly in a drug-induced state and coma during the captivity. In separate later arcs, Stefano hypnotized her and Andre DiMera brainwashed her into believing she was the Salem Stalker serial killer. Her 1994 devil possession is excluded as a qualifying mechanism.
entries.note: Confirmed. This is distinct from the existing “Days of Our Lives (1994–95) — Stefano hypnotizes Marlena” record. The surrogacy and brainwashing arcs are sequential; only the drug-induced coma control was concurrent with the surrogacy.

entries.title: The Young and the Restless — Mariah Copeland
entries.meta: Daytime soap opera · United States · English · CBS
entries.summary: Mariah was a genuine surrogate for Abby Newman and Chance Chancellor, carrying Dominic to term in 2021. In 2025–26 she is described as brainwashed or manipulated by cult leader Ian Ward through visions during a breakdown, leading her to kidnap Dominic, the child she had carried.
entries.note: Probable. The brainwashing came about four years after the surrogacy ended, not concurrently, and the story leaves it ambiguous whether Ian is really present or hallucinated. Sources use the word “brainwashing,” but the plot depicts manipulation through hallucinations during psychosis rather than literal hypnosis or clearly external control.

sections.title: Female hypnotized / mind-controlled by husband, boyfriend, ex-husband or ex-boyfriend
sections.description: Twenty-nine catalog entries in a unified worldwide view of women controlled by a current husband, current boyfriend, ex-husband or ex-boyfriend. sections.description: Twenty-three catalog memberships in which a female character is hypnotized, mind-controlled, brainwashed or magically charmed into agreeing to marry a specific man, undergoing a wedding while controlled, or having children after such a marriage. notes.html: Mechanism and evidence boundary: Cards distinguish literal trance from spells, devices, chips, drugs, occult rituals, dream or timeline manipulation. Attempted and interrupted weddings are labeled. The children-after search produced one verified case, Eterna Magia; an unconfirmed rumor for The Love by Hypnotic remains outside that bucket. The dedicated adult / R-rated / erotic pass found no screen title, while two Japanese adult games were verified through the East Asian route and are clearly labeled. O Beijo do Vampiro is excluded here because its hypnosis-to-pregnancy arc has no marriage.

sections.title: Husband / boyfriend hires a third party to hypnotize / mind-control his wife / girlfriend
sections.description: A male romantic partner pays, hires, or commissions a third party — hypnotist, psychiatrist, occultist, or other controller — to hypnotize, mind-control, brainwash, or magically override the will of his wife, girlfriend, or fiancée. Five verified matches are shown, plus one prominently labeled user-reported record that the reviewed sources do not corroborate.

notes.html: Verified total: 5 matches — 4 research additions plus 1 upgraded existing record. One additional user-reported title is shown separately and is not included in that verified total. Honest-zero regions: Latin America / Spain including telenovelas, Middle East / Turkey, Europe, Japan, Chinese-language markets, Thailand, Indonesia, sub-Saharan Africa, and adult / erotic indexes worldwide. This is the rarest node in the trope family.

sections.title: Mother with children gets pregnant in a passionate relationship (husband, new partner or lover)
sections.description: One hundred seventy catalog memberships covering mothers who already have children and become pregnant again with a husband, new partner or lover, plus clearly labeled scope variants and unresolved leads. The DramaExpress and short-drama-sites sweep adds the FlickReels borderline 七年难孕，再婚后她一胎双宝, whose heroine was not previously a mother, and two LOW-confidence leads: 寒途向新生 and My Don Missed My Last Chance to Be a Mother. The earlier 1 October vertical-short sweep contributes 13 deduplicated records, and the Hallmark sweep adds Three Wisest Men.

sections.title: Polygamy + female hypnosis / mind control
sections.description: Thirty-six category memberships from a worldwide search of films, television series and serials, TV movies, soap operas, documentaries, anime and adult-audience works: 10 strict core matches, 6 concurrent-partner harem variants, 8 coercive-indoctrination cult variants, 9 borderlines and 3 related existing records. Literal hypnosis, possession, occult control and non-literal indoctrination remain clearly separated; confidence, adult / 18+ status and every caveat are shown on the cards.

notes.html: Six leads held outside the catalog: The 19th Wife (2010) — polygamy is certain, but no hypnosis beat is verified; Escape from Polygamy (2013) — mind control is not evidenced in reviews; Hell Is Empty (2021/22) — the sister-wives cult is confirmed, but mind control is not; Sharara / شرارة (Spark) (2026) — one promo describes sihr targeting the husband, not a woman, and episode guides remain unavailable; RadhaKrishn (2018–2023) — Krishna has eight wives and Radha’s memory is magically erased, but Radha is not a wife; and an unidentified Thai lakorn — love spells target the patriarch rather than the women.

sections.title: Polygamy + pregnancy + intimate / sex scenes
sections.description: Ninety-nine worldwide findings linking plural wives, simultaneous partner households, harems or concubines with pregnancy and depicted or reported intimate / sex scenes. The view separates 33 multiple-wife plots, 29 royal-harem or concubine dramas, 8 modern polygamous-household stories, 1 polyandry variant and 28 unresolved leads; adult / R-rated / erotic works and every evidence gap are labeled on the cards.

notes.html: Research boundary: The strict target is one husband or ruler with multiple wives, consorts or simultaneous partner households; pregnancy must matter to the plot; and intimacy or sex must be depicted or directly reported. sections.title: Pregnant woman hypnotized while pregnant — strict core
sections.description: Twelve films, episodes, serial arcs and vertical dramas in which a woman’s will is overridden while her pregnancy is ongoing. Literal hypnosis, villain control, supernatural trance and one hired-hypnotist case are separated by controller; The Womb / Inang adds a verified pregnancy-era hypnosis scene, while I Accidentally Had the Billionaire’s Twins remains included with its timeline-based pregnancy inference explicitly flagged.

notes.html: Strict rule: The same woman must be pregnant while hypnosis, trance or an equivalent will-override is active. Control that only causes pregnancy, non-coercive hypnotherapy, possession without a verified will-override and fetus-targeting rituals are filed in the variants section instead. The 2–3 October sweep upgrades The Womb / Inang after two independent plot explainers confirmed Eva hypnotizes pregnant Wulan into staying until after delivery. O Beijo do Vampiro remains a timing-inferred borderline. For Caminhos do Coração, chapter 147’s hypnosis occurs in the same scene as Amália’s pregnancy announcement.

sections.title: Wife / female character forcibly hypnotized to obey
sections.description: The worldwide index now adds Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees, a ReelShort vertical drama with an official episode-level hypnosis beat, and cross-files O Hipnotizador S02E02 as a clearly labeled false-memory-manipulation variant. Earlier additions include The Photo That Changed Everything, Beneath the Snow, Something Lies Waiting, Alpha, She Wasn’t the One, Stay Away! She’s a Violent Psycho!, the Hallmark sleeper-agent case Jane Doe: How to Fire Your Boss, and El Maleficio (2023) episode 54. A Lover’s Trap remains a separate unresolved LOW-confidence lead.

notes.html: Search boundary: Voluntary therapeutic hypnosis without obedience, fake hypnosis, male-only victims and reverse-direction cases were excluded. Sub-Saharan Africa has ~zero verified matches, no Italian or Spanish-language film match was verified, and Tamil/Kannada remain a structural zero; the Nikkatsu / pinku vein and the Philippines/Indonesia are indexing gaps rather than proof of absence.
